rule: A prompt whose fully-matched type set contains any enumerated pair is assigned unclassified with reason_code ambiguous_precedence_conflict; otherwise the highest-priority fully-matched type is assigned by the chain problem_solution > argumentative > discussion > opinion > general_eap (taxonomy contract section 4).

pairs.rationale: Canonical comparable-strength conflict (taxonomy contract section 4 application rule 2; V1 adjudication A-3). A stance+evidence mandate and a balanced multi-perspective requirement are equally strong rhetorical obligations with materially different routing semantics; no silent choice is made.
pairs.example: Discuss both views and take a position, arguing with evidence.

notes: v1 enumerates only the argumentative/discussion pair as a comparable-strength conflict. V1 adjudication A-1/A-2: discussion+opinion is chain-resolved (viewpoint request is structurally subordinate to the balanced-treatment mandate), not a conflict. A-4: problem_solution+argumentative is chain-resolved (content-anchored problem_solution outranks the rhetorical mandate). All other pairs resolve by the chain.
The conflict outcome (unclassified / ambiguous_precedence_conflict) is a first-class honest state; it is never coerced to a type and never folded into general_eap (contract section 6).
